ask: muse mkae a quik score sheet for the 3 subelts and a vote plz
sentence: Lets each person score three fixed sublets from 1 to 5 on price, commute, outdoor space and AC, then vote for one, with point totals, vote counts and a leader shown.
use_when: A group is choosing between three sublets or apartments and wants to score them side by side
People want to rate options on a few set criteria and then cast one vote
A quick tally of points and votes is needed to settle a housing choice
dont_use_when: The options or criteria are different from the three sublets and four criteria built in
Only a simple yes or no or single-choice poll is needed with no scoring
Splitting rent or costs between people is the job

origin.title: summer sublet crew
origin.text:
ok summer sublets, we gotta pick by friday
i found 3. one in astoria, one in bushwick, one in jersey city
astoria is 1900/mo for the whole thing, 2 bedrooms + a pullout
bushwick is 1650 but its only 2 beds no pullout, and the l train is a pain
jersey city is 1500, 3 beds, 8 min from path
i want a roof or balcony tbh
astoria has a balcony. jc has a roof
bushwick has neither lol
i care most about commute to my internship in midtown
astoria is 25 min on the n, jc is like 35, bushwick 50
honestly price matters most for me. im broke
jc wins on price then
but jc has no ac in the living room rip
astoria has ac everywhere
so like price, commute, outdoor space, ac
yeah those 4
someone has to just rank them already
